statement: Bit-exact preservation. With W=2, H=1, P=2, shiftX=0, shiftY=0, source S[0]=binary32 bit pattern 0x00000001 (smallest positive subnormal) and S[1]=binary32 bit pattern 0x80000000 (-0.0), the candidate must produce output O[0] bitwise identical to 0x00000001 and O[1] bitwise identical to 0x80000000; a bitwise comparator over those two output words must pass, not merely a numeric-equality comparator.
